summary: 周日没有新的 EIP 或论坛提案。tcoratger 介绍 ethresear 上的 leanDA：现有 DAS 依赖不抗量子的 KZG 承诺，leanDA 采用“编码加证明”的后量子构造。hasufl 就发行争论表态，认为向被动持有者收费、资助投资生态的项目是好事。gakonst 谈加密金融基础设施长期面对的攻击压力。

items.title: tcoratger：以太坊用 DAS 安全扩展 blob 数据，但现有 DAS 依赖不抗量子的 KZG 承诺

summary_en: Sunday brought no new EIPs or forum proposals. tcoratger introduced leanDA from ethresear: today's DAS relies on KZG commitments that are not post-quantum secure, and leanDA uses an "encode plus prove" post-quantum construction. hasufl weighed in on the issuance debate, arguing that charging passive holders to fund projects that invest in the ecosystem is good. gakonst described the constant attack pressure on crypto financial infrastructure.
